field.label: Enable
field.help: Run the SurveillanceHound daemon at boot.

field.label: Listen interface
field.help: The NIC the surveillance traffic crosses. On OPNsense this is typically the camera VLAN or a SPAN/mirror port. Single interface only — use a BPF filter below to narrow within it.

field.label: Snaplen (bytes)
field.help: Bytes captured per packet for flow analysis. 96 covers all header layers; raise to 1500 if enabling snapshots.

field.label: Camera subnets
field.help: Comma-separated CIDRs. Anything in here is treated as a camera unless also listed as an NVR.

field.label: Manufacturer allowlist (CIDRs)
field.help: The vendor cloud your cameras legitimately talk to.

field.label: Silence threshold (seconds)
field.help: A camera with no observed packets for this long raises camera_offline. Detection is PASSIVE — Hound only watches traffic that crosses the listen interface, it never probes or pings the camera. A camera that is still powered and recording but no longer visible to this sensor (VLAN moved, mirror port reconfigured) looks exactly like one that is powered down. Default 600.

field.label: Track per-camera uptime
field.help: Record outage history and availability per camera, derived from observed traffic only (PASSIVE — no probing). Adds the camera_recovered, camera_never_seen and capture_stalled alert kinds. On by default.

field.label: Startup grace (seconds)
field.help: After the daemon starts, wait this long before alerting on a configured camera that has not been seen yet — otherwise every restart would fire camera_never_seen for cameras that are simply idle. 0 inherits the silence threshold above. Default 600.

field.label: Capture stall timeout (seconds)
field.help: Dead-man's switch: if ZERO packets at all are captured for this long, the sensor is blind, so one capture_stalled alert fires and per-camera offline alerts are suppressed until capture recovers. Without it a dead tcpdump looks identical to every camera failing at once. 0 disables. Default 120.

field.label: z threshold
field.help: Standard deviations from the bucket mean before an anomaly alert fires (default 4.0).

field.label: Min samples per bucket
field.help: Cold-start guard — no anomalies fire until each (camera, weekday, hour) bucket has this many observations.

field.label: Enable per-camera pcap snapshots on alert
Bind host
field.help: 127.0.0.1 keeps it loopback-only. Bind to a routable address only behind your own auth/proxy.

field.label: TLS cert (optional)
field.help: Absolute path to a PEM-encoded TLS certificate. Leave blank to inherit OPNsense's own UI scheme: HTTPS by default (a self-signed cert is auto-generated and stored under /var/lib/hound/), HTTP if OPNsense itself runs HTTP. The dashboard's scheme must match the firewall UI's or browsers block the embedded iframe as mixed content.

field.label: TLS private key (optional)
field.help: Absolute path to the matching PEM private key.
